purpose: A first evidence-oriented corpus of Tree of Strife patterns derived from the Mud/Karma/Farm model. These are analytical patterns, not accusations against unnamed actors.

records.name: Smear Accumulation
records.potatoverse_reading: Mud thrown at a neighbour accumulates on the target and can also remain attached to the thrower through archives, counterclaims and reputational memory.
records.empirical_mechanism: Repeated negative claims can create a durable information record even when the underlying claim is disputed, corrected or disproven.

records.name: Litigation Debt
records.potatoverse_reading: A dispute becomes a ledger of unresolved obligations: claims, responses, costs, judgments and possible restitution.
records.empirical_mechanism: A legal dispute creates formal documents, deadlines, fees, claims, defenses and potentially enforceable monetary or non-monetary outcomes.

records.name: Attention Milk
records.potatoverse_reading: The Farm harvests reactions; conflict and suffering become milk when converted into attention and then into rewards.
records.empirical_mechanism: Digital and media systems can convert audience attention into advertising, subscriptions, donations, memberships, merchandise or political mobilization.

records.name: Negative-Attention Feedback
records.potatoverse_reading: Suffering feeds the Farm when distress produces more spectacle, and spectacle produces more attention.
records.empirical_mechanism: Negative or emotionally arousing events can generate repeated coverage and audience interaction, creating feedback between event salience and content production.

records.name: Compromat Archive
records.potatoverse_reading: Mud becomes stored leverage: once a compromising record exists, it can remain attached to a relationship long after the original event.
records.empirical_mechanism: Documented compromising information may be archived, published, investigated, litigated over or used in bargaining. The existence of material must be distinguished from claims about its meaning.

records.name: Donor-Influence Loop
records.potatoverse_reading: Milk can be financial: attention and alignment are harvested into donations, while donations can finance more attention-producing activity.
records.empirical_mechanism: Political committees and nonprofits receive funds and spend them on communications, organizing, advocacy or other permitted activities; the graph must distinguish legal purpose from inferred influence.

records.name: Ownership Entanglement
records.potatoverse_reading: Two neighbours appear separate above the mud but share roots below it.
records.empirical_mechanism: Common parent companies, subsidiaries, beneficial ownership, directors or contractual dependencies connect entities that look independent at the surface.

records.name: Procurement Dependency
records.potatoverse_reading: A neighbour becomes tied to a Farm because essential milk, tools or infrastructure come through one narrow root.
records.empirical_mechanism: A government or institution can become operationally dependent on a supplier where procurement is concentrated or switching costs are high.

records.name: Revolving-Door Entanglement
records.potatoverse_reading: The farmer and the neighbour exchange roles, causing yesterday's relationship to remain inside tomorrow's institution.
records.empirical_mechanism: People can move between government, industry, lobbying, consulting, journalism, academia and advocacy; the movement is observable, while claims of improper influence require additional evidence.

records.name: Institutional Mud
records.potatoverse_reading: Unresolved contradictions accumulate inside institutions until the institution carries its own mud: duplicated mandates, conflicting incentives and procedural residue.
records.empirical_mechanism: Overlapping authorities and fragmented processes can create administrative cost, unclear accountability and repeated work.

records.name: Conflict-Fundraising Loop
records.potatoverse_reading: A conflict produces milk, milk finances the Farm, and the funded Farm can produce more conflict-oriented communication.
records.empirical_mechanism: Organizations may fundraise around salient political or social conflicts. The existence of fundraising does not establish that an organization created the conflict.

records.name: Archive Debt
records.potatoverse_reading: Every thrown piece of mud leaves a trace in the Farm's memory, making future interpretation dependent on accumulated history.
records.empirical_mechanism: Web archives, court files, news databases, public filings and social-media reposts preserve historical claims and relationships.

records.name: Debt Cascade
records.potatoverse_reading: One unresolved debt becomes mud for another neighbour, creating a chain rather than a single obligation.
records.empirical_mechanism: Financial obligations can propagate through creditors, suppliers, insurers, guarantors and refinancing relationships.

records.name: Platform Dependency
records.potatoverse_reading: The Farm's path narrows when many neighbours depend on one gatekeeper to reach their audience.
records.empirical_mechanism: Creators, publishers and businesses may depend on dominant distribution platforms whose rules, algorithms, fees or access conditions affect reach.

records.name: Reputational Reciprocity
records.potatoverse_reading: Mud thrown outward can rebound through counterclaims, investigations and public responses, entangling both parties.
records.empirical_mechanism: Public disputes often produce reciprocal statements, reporting, legal responses and evidence publication.

records.name: Repair Ledger
records.potatoverse_reading: Not all mud must remain mud: restitution, correction, apology, reform and reconciliation can transform the accumulated residue.
records.empirical_mechanism: Institutions and individuals can issue corrections, settle disputes, compensate affected parties, change policy or restore relationships.

records.name: Ten-Thousand-Neighbour Expansion
records.potatoverse_reading: The 10,000 neighbours are not ten thousand invented victims; they are the corpus capacity for tracing many observable relational cases through the Swamp.
records.empirical_mechanism: A graph can scale from individual disputes to organizations, companies, institutions and communities when each edge has a source and evidence state.

records.name: Moloch Escalation
records.potatoverse_reading: Participants feed a system they may dislike because refusing to participate carries a cost; the system therefore consumes more resources as each participant responds to the others.
records.empirical_mechanism: Competitive escalation can arise in arms races, advertising, political spending, status competition and other settings where unilateral restraint is costly.

records.name: Moral-Bankruptcy Proxy
records.potatoverse_reading: Repeatedly spending trust can leave an actor symbolically bankrupt even when no single event explains the whole loss.
records.empirical_mechanism: Trust or legitimacy can be studied through observable proxies such as survey measures, membership, donor retention, advertiser relationships, resignations, regulatory findings and repeated adverse findings.

records.name: Mud-to-Data Conversion
records.potatoverse_reading: The final transformation is to stop treating mud as merely symbolic residue and turn every observable trace into a structured record that can be checked, connected and revised.
records.empirical_mechanism: Claims become useful research objects when source, date, actor, target, evidence status, relationship, consequence and uncertainty are recorded separately.
